import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
point1 = ee.Geometry.Point([46.929987337866386, -119.02882425044682])
point2 = ee.Geometry.Point([43.19114225407087, -119.70997639198902])
date = '2015-11-29'
date_start = ee.Date(date)
date_end = date_start.advance(1, 'day')

# 2. Data Acquisition - Try Landsat 8 first (more likely for 2015)
l8_col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .filterBounds(point1.union(point2))

print(f"Landsat 8 images found: {l8_col.size().getInfo()}")

if l8_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No Landsat 8 data for 2015-11-29.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Check cloud coverage at both points
    # Use QA_PIXEL band for Landsat 8 Collection 2
    img = l8_col.first()
    qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
    
    # Bit 3: Cloud
    # Bit 4: Cloud Shadow
    cloud_bit = 1 << 3
    
    # Sample QA values at both points
    sample1 = qa.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
        geometry=point1,
        scale=30
    ).get('QA_PIXEL').getInfo()
    
    sample2 = qa.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.first(),
        geometry=point2,
        scale=30
    ).get('QA_PIXEL').getInfo()
    
    print(f"Point 1 QA value: {sample1}")
    print(f"Point 2 QA value: {sample2}")
    
    # 4. Validation
    if sample1 is None or sample2 is None:
        print("Could not retrieve cloud information.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Check if cloud bit is set
        point1_cloudy = bool(sample1 & cloud_bit)
        point2_cloudy = bool(sample2 & cloud_bit)
        
        print(f"Point 1 (46.93, -119.03) cloudy: {point1_cloudy}")
        print(f"Point 2 (43.19, -119.71) cloudy: {point2_cloudy}")
        
        # 5. Final Answer
        if point1_cloudy and point2_cloudy:
            print("Both locations are covered by clouds.")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("At least one location is NOT covered by clouds.")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
